key_insight: The paper develops an FE2 multiscale framework that couples a shear-deformable beam model at the structural scale with a truss-based lattice micro-model to efficiently capture periodic lattice-like beam behavior.
engineering_relevance: This enables accurate and computationally efficient analysis of load-bearing lattice members made by additive manufacturing, especially when beam-like global response must reflect detailed microstructural architecture.
method: Shear-deformable 3D beam FE2 at the macro scale
Periodic truss RVE with displacement boundary conditions at the micro scale
Constraint equations plus local correction factors to suppress rigid-body modes and reduce boundary artifacts
evidence_signal: Numerical studies on two- and three-dimensional lattice geometries, including linear and nonlinear cases, show RVE-length independence and good agreement with reference models.
watch_item: The framework relies on carefully designed constraints and correction factors, so implementation must avoid spurious boundary effects and ensure robust RVE handling.
paper_title: An FE2 model for shear-deformable beams considering periodic lattice-like truss mesostructures
